description: The ordered structure a change will be built through, settled before anything is written. test_first is required and separate from steps: a plan that lists the check after the change it checks cannot distinguish a passing check from one written to pass, which is the failure this repository's change discipline exists to close.

test_first.description: The checks that land before the change, each with the failure it is expected to show first.

expected_before.description: What this check reports while the change is absent.

files_touched.description: Paths the plan commits to changing. A path outside this list is a departure to be recorded, not a silent extension.

tradeoffs.description: Steps where more than one structure would have served, and why this one was taken.

rollback.description: How the change is undone if the verdict fails.
